pages.title: File:Q. Pompeius Rufus, denarius, 54 BC, RRC 434-1 (Sulla only).jpg

ObjectName.value: Q. Pompeius Rufus, denarius, 54 BC, RRC 434-1 (Sulla only)

Categories.value: GFDL|License migration not eligible|Self-published work|CNG coins|Items with VRTS permission confirmed|Roman Republican silver denari|Coins by Q. Pompeius Rufus|Head of Sulla on coins

ImageDescription.value:
Q. Pompeius Rufus. 54 BC. AR Denarius (19mm, 3.21 g, 6h). Rome mint. Bare head of the consul Q. Pompeius Rufus right / Bare head of Sulla right. Crawford 434/1; Sydenham 908; Pompeia 4. Good VF, toned, some light cleaning scratches and marks under tone. Rare.

Ex Numismatica Ars Classica 78 (26 May 2014), lot 458; Sternberg [VI] (25 November 1976), lot 755.

This coin issue bears the only portrait of the dictator Sulla. The moneyer was the grandson of Sulla and his home would likely have had portraits of their famous ancestor. Thus, although posthumously struck, the portrait on these coins is probably an accurate representation.

Attribution.value: Classical Numismatic Group, Inc. http://www.cngcoins.com

Jovian. AD 363-364. AV Solidus (21mm, 4.46 g, 12h). Antioch mint, 7th officina.
